title: Code and data for: Positivity preservation in matrix-valued Caputo evolution equations: continuous problem, L1 time stepping, and residual-based neural networks
description:
Source code, configuration files, raw numerical results, tables and figures for the article Positivity preservation in matrix-valued Caputo evolution equations: continuous problem, L1 time stepping, and residual-based neural networks: Caputo time-fractional evolution of positive-semidefinite matrix states, L1 time stepping on uniform and graded meshes, sum-of-exponentials history, and physics-informed networks with admissible output maps.

Benchmarks: verification experiments E1-E5; scalar and matrix-valued forward and inverse problems B1, B2, B6 and B7 and a parametric surrogate; the laser-driven massive-Dirac model B3 and B4; the conformation tensor of a viscoelastic fluid B5.

The archive contains the Python package fracsp with its tests, the experiment drivers and their configurations, every raw result with a provenance record, and the scripts that regenerate all tables and figures from the raw results in about two minutes. See README.md for the layout, the installation and the commands.

Licences: source code MIT; data and figures CC BY 4.0.
